device_entry.description: 用于连接实验室仪器管理服务器的客户端组件，可与服务器建立连接、发送请求并断开连接，适合远程仪器访问与实验自动化控制场景。
device_entry.description_en: A client component for connecting to a laboratory instrument management server. It can establish a connection, send requests, and disconnect, supporting remote instrument access and lab automation workflows.

schema.description_en: Disconnect from the instrument management server.
